name: MeTube
description: A web interface for yt-dlp: paste a video or playlist link, pick a format and quality, and the download lands in a folder on this server.

access.note: MeTube has no accounts: anyone who reaches the address can queue downloads onto this server's disk and fetch what others downloaded. Keep the domain behind the dashboard's password protection unless the address is private. Downloads go to the downloads volume, which is kept across redeploys but not backed up by default, since media is large and can be fetched again.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The page, its API and the download progress stream

volumes.name: downloads
volumes.purpose: Downloaded media and the queue state; large, so kept but not backed up by default

update.notes: Tags are dated builds that mainly carry a newer yt-dlp, which is what stops working when sites change; updating often is the point. The queue and completed-download state on the volume is read as it is.
